softRemoved.description: Whether the entity has been soft-removed

title:
Can be mixed by an entity type to provide a way to soft-remove the object. A soft-removed object will still exist in
the database and will remain fetchable, but will have the `softRemoved` field set to `true`.

This prevents undesired downstream effects when objects are removed. For example, the soft-removal of an
{@link ExMachinaProjectRoot} will still allow interactions with any downstream {@link ExMachinaProject}s,
{@link ExMachinaPipeline}s, {@link ExMachinaDatasetTopic}s, etc. without causing unintended issues.
name: ExMachinaSoftRemovable
